age-calculator.colorPalette: azure-blue primary hsl(217 91% 55%) / mint-green accent hsl(142 71% 45%) / warm off-white light surfaces / deep navy dark
age-calculator.typography: Inter heading+body; JetBrains Mono for result numbers
age-calculator.heroComposition: calendar ring SVG with animated arc sweep showing time-elapsed; floating date-chip overlays on hero

age-calculator.microInteractions: count-up animation 0→final over 800ms on reveal; confetti burst on birthday detection; prefers-reduced-motion respected
